title: Scaffolding Minds: Optimizing Latent Visual Target Representations for Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.19669v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent reasoning has advanced multimodal reasoning through a two-stage training paradigm: (1) a helper image is encoded into latent tokens to teach visual chain-of-thought during a supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage, and (2) these latent tokens are further refined with reward feedback during a reinforcement learning (RL) stage. In this paper, we identify two key limitations of this framework, one in each stage. First, the SFT stage typically relies on an off-the-shelf vision encoder to encode the helper image, yielding suboptimal latent representations that may not be well aligned with the downstream reasoning task. Second, existing RL methods treat the latent component only through deterministic regularization, which constrains policy drift but does not create alternative latent trajectories for exploration. translated_title: 思维脚手架：优化多模态推理中的潜在视觉目标表征
translated_abstract: 潜在推理通过两阶段训练范式推进了多模态推理：（1）在监督微调（SFT）阶段，辅助图像被编码为潜在令牌，以教授视觉思维链；（2）在强化学习（RL）阶段，这些潜在令牌通过奖励反馈进一步细化。本文中，我们识别了该框架的两个关键限制，分别出现在每个阶段。首先，SFT阶段通常依赖现成的视觉编码器来编码辅助图像，导致潜在表征次优，可能无法与下游推理任务良好对齐。其次，现有RL方法仅通过确定性正则化处理潜在组件，这限制了策略漂移，但未创建替代潜在轨迹以供探索。为解决这些限制，我们提出了Scaffolding Minds。我们的方法学习一个专用脚手架编码器，它提供...
tldr: 本文提出Scaffolding Minds方法，通过专用脚手架编码器优化潜在视觉表征，并改进强化学习中的潜在轨迹探索，从而解决多模态推理中两阶段训练框架的关键限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Scaffolding Minds, which optimizes latent visual representations via a dedicated scaffolding encoder and improves latent trajectory exploration in reinforcement learning, addressing key limitations in the two-stage training framework for multimodal reasoning.
